global_issues.title: Taiwan charges Nvidia worker in AI server smuggling to China
global_issues.note: Confirmed by Bloomberg, Washington Post, Reuters, Al Jazeera, Taipei Times (2026-08-24/25). Taiwan indicted 9 people including an Nvidia Taiwan manager (surnamed Chang) and two Super Micro employees for smuggling 74 AI servers with B300 chips to China via Japan/Indonesia; a second 56-server shipment was seized. Semiconductor tariff figure (~70%) also checks out — it reflects stacked Section 301 layers (50% base + 12.5% forced-labor + 7.5% overcapacity) reported by TechTimes as finalizing in late August 2026.

global_issues.title: Oil drops >3% as US pivots to economic sanctions on Iran
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC, Reuters/Yahoo, Oil & Gas Journal (2026-08-24/25): Brent fell ~4.2% and WTI ~3.9% to a one-week low as markets judged the new sanctions (targeting Iranian digital assets, tech, gold, aviation, shipping) as less disruptive than feared military escalation.

missing_major_news.title: Canada announces sweeping retaliatory tariffs (~$20B of US goods, 15/25/50% rates, effective Sept 8) after US-Canada trade talks collapsed
missing_major_news.impact: Was the dominant market driver on 2026-08-25 per CNBC/Yahoo — S&P 500 (+0.32% to 7,677.28) and Nasdaq rose as investors 'shrugged off' the trade tension while chip names rallied instead. This directly affects sentiment context around AMZN, MSFT, AAPL and broader tech/industrials exposed to Canada trade, and is the actual reason cited for the day's index gains rather than the Iran/Taiwan stories alone.
